==Mechanics==
The regular tree category includes trees that give regular logs when cut down. The tree respawns between 36–60 seconds, randomly. The chance to successfully chop is affected by the [[Hatchets|hatchet]] used and Woodcutting level, better hatchets and a higher Woodcutting level increases the likelihood of successfully receiving a log. [[Seer's headband 1]] and above gives double logs when cutting any normal tree.
